_note: resolver is the address the one-shot prints (deterministic: it is in the plan before you send anything). agents are the ones with ENS names; label and agentId must match the agent-registration record on the name. fromBlock is the Base Sepolia block in which these agents were registered (55035459), so no earlier outcomes are read. knownCategories only turns a category hash back into a label; any category not listed is shown as its hash.
